snippet.title: Let's Play PSX: Carnage Heart EZ (Japan)
snippet.description: This is basically a revamp of Carnage Heart. Basically everything is better. The graphics in battle are a little nicer. The menus are easier to navigate (such as defaulting to producing 40 mechs instead of 0). Also, the game helps you build your AI by providing a whole series of movement and attack macros. You can easily mix and match them according to your strategy, and get into the game a lot easier than trying to figure it all out from scratch.
